US Social Security faces potential 2032 benefit cuts

The US Social Security system could face a 22% benefit cut starting in 2032, according to projections by the Congressional Budget Office. Discussions are underway regarding potential changes to address this shortfall. One proposed bill suggests lowering the retirement age to 60 for some workers.
